rules: 2x3 manuscript grammar with one question per panel
paired lines without redundant point markers
negative/boundary results remain in the main logic when they establish a gate
historical inventories remain provenance/ED rather than the main visual narrative

figure_messages.Fig1: Biological identity reads specific functional coordinates at circuit-dependent resolution.
figure_messages.Fig2: Reference recovery, candidate selection and held-unit functional utility are separate gates.
figure_messages.Fig3: Compact molecular panels require an explicit assay contract and objective.
